composer.startSubtitle: Describe it in your own words — type or speak. We fill in the form; you check it.

describePlaceholder.any: e.g. Need 2 delivery riders in Kukatpally, ₹15,000–18,000 a month, own bike, 9 am to 7 pm
describePlaceholder.employment: e.g. Need 2 delivery riders in Kukatpally, ₹15,000–18,000 a month, own bike, 9 am to 7 pm
describePlaceholder.freelance: e.g. Need someone to set up Tally for my kirana shop and file GST for 3 months, budget ₹20,000–30,000
describePlaceholder.local_service: e.g. Plumber needed today in Madhapur, kitchen sink is leaking, budget ₹800

composer.describeHint: Hindi, Telugu, English or a mix — all fine.

examples.employment: Hiring 2 delivery riders in KPHB Colony, Kukatpally. ₹15,000 to ₹18,000 a month plus incentives. Own two-wheeler and licence. 10th pass, freshers welcome. 9 am to 7 pm.
examples.freelance: Need an accountant to set up Tally for my kirana shop in Ameerpet and file GST for 3 months. Fixed budget ₹20,000 to ₹30,000.
examples.local_service: Need a plumber today in Madhapur — kitchen sink is leaking. Budget ₹800.
